justdirethings_area_preview_chunk_memo.conversion: MixinExtras @WrapOperation on renderAreaPreviews' chunk.getBlockEntities(): per chunk (identity, weak) the switch keeps for one second whether the chunk held an AreaAffectingBE with renderArea set; while it held none, an empty map is answered and the chunk is not walked. Trade-off (off by default): a preview switched on, or a new block with its preview on, can show up to one second later; chunks with a shown preview are walked every frame. Runtime flag justdirethingsAreaPreviewChunkMemo. Helper bons.furious.patch.justdirethings_coo49.AreaPreviews.
